commit.message:
Strength 3, q = 4: SCPHF(16; 90723, 4, 3), the missing rung of the ladder, with three exact checks and its ca-tools certificate

CA(964; 3, k, 4) for every k <= 90,723. Checks of every column triple: pq_scphf3_bigcheck.c on our coding and on the released file (Conway coding), and fullcheck3.c, a second checker written separately (added to checker/). The certificate in the form of ca-tools pull request #51 is in ca-tools/submissions/canli-2026-11-t3-k90723/.
